description: Experimentally constrained ligand, metal, contact or assembly facts on a homolog, related to the target through actual sequence or structural correspondence.

evidence.limit: Relevant primary structural/results passages inspected; complete supplement not read.
evidence.observation: Activity-guided D-threonate complex and ADP complex localized distinct substrate/nucleotide sites; ADP structure showed domain closure.

evidence.limit: Relevant primary indexed passages inspected; no full supplement reanalysis or new assay.
evidence.observation: Complex structures distinguished catalytic and allosteric binding sites.

evidence.limit: Primary abstract/methods and initial context read; complete results not read in this pass.
evidence.observation: Structure revealed binuclear zinc and a separate phosphate-binding environment.

evidence.limit: Primary relevant results plus 1WUB inspected; complete methods not read.
evidence.observation: Density in the hydrophobic barrel was modeled as octaprenyl pyrophosphate; mass spectrometry supported a C40 isoprenoid.

evidence.limit: Three primary E. coli relevant Results/Methods inspected, with earlier other-species nuclease comparators explicitly limited; new descriptive deposited-coordinate comparison. No biological experiments or new annotation run. | Source observation limit: Contact presence alone does not establish functional necessity: R77 is an explicit tolerated contact-site example. Not every Cas2 contact mutant was directly assayed for binding affinity in isolation.
evidence.observation: A four-Cas1/two-Cas2 complex positions the central donor duplex over Cas2 and terminal donor 3-prime ends in two Cas1 sites. Cas2 R16/R78 are part of a phosphate-backbone clamp; R16E and R78E strongly reduce in vivo acquisition, whereas R77E is tolerated. Cas1 clamp/channel and end-splaying mutants supply additional functional comparisons.

evidence.limit: Full primary Results on architecture, length threshold, pore-loop mutants and crosslinking read. No structural re-refinement. | Group source-use limits: Cryo-EM, crosslinking and complementation are different connected modalities; they are not three direct transport assays. Lipid identity, direction and net flux remain unresolved.
evidence.observation: Structure shows a periplasm-length hydrophobic tunnel. Lipid crosslinking places phosphate-bearing material inside it. Length and pore-loop mutants lose ability to complement a sensitized pqiAB/letAB detergent phenotype.

evidence.limit: Full relevant primary results/methods in both papers; independent read-only 7LC5 coordinate probe recorded separately. No cultures, mass-spectrometric assays or mechanism reconstruction rerun.
evidence.observation: Structure placed Cys9/Cys10 at a separate metal site; in-vitro oQ decreased without detectable Q product.

evidence.limit: 2013 main narrative, modeling assumptions and stated assay outcomes inspected; detailed supplementary assay protocols not independently checked. 2019 complete relevant activity/results/discussion and assay conditions inspected. Original 2011 paper not newly verified.
evidence.observation: Bound electron density was modeled as hexanoate but remained an unknown ligand; docking could not determine native chemistry.

outcomes.met: The source identifies an experimentally constrained structure/model of the stated homolog/construct and preserves the experimental method, preparation and limits on the structural fact being used.
outcomes.not_met: The claimed experimental fact is demonstrably a wholly predicted, docked or simulated result, or belongs to a different subject/construct from the one claimed.
outcomes.unknown: Experimental origin, studied subject, model identity or the relevant method/validation information is unavailable or ambiguous.

judgment_criteria.question: Is the cited structural fact experimentally constrained and assigned to the actual studied homolog?

outcomes.met: Received experimental/model evidence supports the stated ligand/metal/contact/architecture assignment within its reported ambiguity, including exact chains/sites or assembly relationship needed for the claim.
outcomes.not_met: Received evidence identifies an incompatible ligand, partner, site or architecture, or contradicts the assigned structural state.
outcomes.unknown: Density or a compatible model does not identify the claimed ligand/state, alternatives remain unresolved, or the relevant contact/assembly was not observed. A docked candidate is not an observed ligand.

judgment_criteria.question: Does the structural evidence identify the ligand, metal, contact or architecture actually being claimed?

outcomes.met: An actual sequence or structural correspondence maps the observed homolog feature to the relevant target region and preserves matching geometry/architecture plus function-relevant differences.
outcomes.not_met: The received mapping excludes the necessary region, identifies a different target relationship or demonstrates an incompatible feature that rejects the proposed transfer.
outcomes.unknown: The correspondence, relevant site mapping or informative target feature comparison has not been established. A global fold similarity alone does not map a specific ligand/contact claim.

judgment_criteria.question: Does the homolog-to-target correspondence cover the structural feature relevant to the candidate annotation?

outcomes.met: The target interpretation preserves the bounded structural observation and correspondence; any claim of affinity, catalysis, transport or necessity is tied to its actual separate functional evidence or retained as unestablished.
outcomes.not_met: The interpretation presents occupancy/contact/architecture as proof of a functional property contradicted by received functional evidence, or misrepresents a model-derived contact as an independent functional measurement.
outcomes.unknown: The available structural state does not distinguish the claimed molecular function, ligand identity or physiological responsibility, and the necessary functional comparisons have not been received.

judgment_criteria.question: Is the target interpretation limited to what the mapped experimental structural state establishes?

outcomes.met: The actual native p/q or equivalent reported test concerns this claim-relative positive contrast, the observed direction agrees, required controls are valid and statistic/multiplicity meaning is retained.
outcomes.not_met: The native statistic concerns another hypothesis, an opposite effect, invalid controls or a contrast that does not distinguish the stated claim.
outcomes.unknown: The relevant native test, contrast, direction, controls or statistic interpretation has not been received.

judgment_criteria.question: Does the native formal test address the positive claim with the actual observed direction?

outcomes.met: The native statistic comes from an actual competent exclusion/equivalence or detection-limit test for this claim under its conditions; its margin, direction and assay limits are retained.
outcomes.not_met: The result is only an ordinary nonsignificant difference or failed preparation, or tests a different claim/condition.
outcomes.unknown: No actual claim-excluding native test, source-defined margin or necessary competence/limit information has been received.

judgment_criteria.question: Does the native formal test actually exclude the stated claim within the tested scope?

outcomes.met: An experimentally constrained model actually contains the relevant density/contact/architecture on the identified construct/site; ambiguity in chemical assignment remains explicit.
outcomes.not_met: The feature is absent from the cited model, wholly predicted/docked, or assigned to a different construct/site.
outcomes.unknown: The relevant actual feature/model/site or experimental validation has not been received.

judgment_criteria.question: Is the relevant physical feature actually observed in the experimental model, even if its assignment remains ambiguous?

outcomes.met: An actual observed alternative state or matched site/partner comparison distinguishes the stated structural interpretation from its specified competing explanation.
outcomes.not_met: The comparison contradicts the claimed distinction or concerns an unrelated state/site.
outcomes.unknown: Only one compatible state or an untested modeled alternative is available; the stated alternatives are not experimentally distinguished.

judgment_criteria.question: Does an actual alternative-state or matched-site comparison distinguish the precise structural interpretation?

outcomes.met: An actual orthogonal chemical/state identification or selective functional comparison tests the specific structural interpretation on the stated subject and preserves which facts are structural versus functional.
outcomes.not_met: The orthogonal/selective result contradicts that structural interpretation or refers to a different subject/relationship.
outcomes.unknown: No relevant orthogonal/selective test has been received. A distance computed from the same coordinates is not another measurement principle.

judgment_criteria.question: Does another measurement principle or selective functional comparison test the specific structural interpretation?

outcomes.met: An actual experimentally constrained, sufficiently informative observation demonstrates a feature/site/state incompatible with the exact structural claim under its preparation conditions.
outcomes.not_met: The cited observation is merely missing/unresolved density, an untested modeled alternative or a wholly predicted structure, or the actual feature supports the claim.
outcomes.unknown: The relevant site/state, experimental validation or informative structural limits are unavailable.

judgment_criteria.question: Does actual structural evidence contradict the precise feature/state claimed?

outcomes.met: The source positively identifies the incompatible alternative ligand/contact/architecture at the actual matched site/subject with its assignment limits retained.
outcomes.not_met: The proposed alternative remains an unidentified fit/density or concerns another site/subject.
outcomes.unknown: An experimentally discriminating alternative assignment is unavailable.

judgment_criteria.question: Is an incompatible alternative state positively identified rather than inferred from absent density?

comparison_limits: A p/q-value is not a probability of function. Negative-log10 is a declared monotone evidence-statistic scale, not confidence.
Nonsignificance does not establish no effect; opposition requires an actual equivalence/detection-limit or other claim-excluding test.
Do not combine unlike tests, unadjusted families or repeated literature/dataset representations by summing their scores.
method_requirements: Retain the actual statistic type, null and alternative, contrast/effect direction, analysis method, sample/replicate unit and multiplicity handling. Prefer the reported adjusted q-value for the same family when available; do not count p and q as two independent results.
The source-native statistic must test this formal claim or its competent exclusion, with actual controls and experiment/measurement identity. An unrelated small p-value is not eligible.

No ordinary Store metric currently binds this quantity. It is unknown unless an actual retained/formal dataset or source measurement supplies the native value and provenance; no JSON pointer is invented.
native_measurements.name: Source-reported p-value or multiplicity-adjusted q-value for the actual claim-relative contrast

transfer_chain.correspondence: Link the homolog structural fact to the target through an actual sequence or structural mapping of the relevant residues, site, domain or assembly surface.
transfer_chain.limitations: Do not relabel homolog observations as target measurements or a wholly predicted/docked model as experimental evidence. Coordinate-derived measurements share the structure dependency; a contact does not by itself establish affinity, turnover or necessity.
transfer_chain.source_property: Retain the observed ligand/metal state, contacts or architecture, its model origin, native quantities and assignment limits. TT1927b and FrsA retain their ligand-identity ambiguity; a Cas2 contact retains the limits of its functional tests.
transfer_chain.source_subject: Identify the actual experimentally studied homolog, construct, preparation, chains and assembly; the target need not already have its own experimental structure.
transfer_chain.target_hypothesis: State which candidate target feature or function the mapped structural fact bears on, retaining the distinction between physical compatibility and demonstrated activity.
